Estimated items before eating:
- Cake slice: about 90 g, roughly 300 kcal (sponge with cream frosting). Nearly all eaten, leaving a few crumbs, so about 280 kcal and 85 g.
- Sushi rolls: 4 kimbap/maki pieces, about 25 g each, so about 100 g and 150 kcal. Plus 2 rice paper rolls, about 60 g each, so about 120 g and 140 kcal. One rice paper roll was mostly left over, so I count about 1.3 of them eaten. That gives roughly 100 g of maki and about 80 g of rice paper roll eaten, about 250 kcal in total.
- Pickled ginger or carrot cup: about 15 g, 10 kcal. It looks eaten.
- Soy sauce: about 15 g, 10 kcal. Some of it remains, so I count about 5 kcal.
- Juice: about 200 g, 90 kcal. Mostly drunk, with a little left, so about 170 g and 75 kcal.
- Fruit bowl: about 150 g, 70 kcal. All eaten.

Totals eaten: about 280 + 250 + 10 + 5 + 75 + 70 = 690 kcal. Mass is about 85 + 180 + 15 + 8 + 170 + 150 = 608 g.
